props.name: autofocus
props.description: Focus the textarea on mount (after `autofocusDelay` ms).

props.name: avatar
props.description: When set, render `<VyAvatar>` in the leading slot instead of an icon.

props.name: avoidKeyboard
props.description:
Native keyboard avoidance (Lynx `avoid-keyboard`) — see `VyInput`'s prop of
the same name. Do NOT combine with a `VyKeyboardAwareRoot`.

props.name: avoidKeyboardSpacing
props.description: Extra clearance in px above the keyboard when `avoidKeyboard` is set.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Paints a static ring matching `color`, ignoring focus state.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Iconify shorthand, routed to the trailing side when `trailing` is set and
the leading side otherwise. Explicit `leadingIcon` / `trailingIcon` win.

props.name: leading
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the leading side.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the leading side (wins over `icon`).

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the spinner. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.loading`.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Max input length. Forwarded to the underlying core `<textarea>`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows. Forwarded to the underlying core `<textarea>`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the trailing side.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the trailing side (wins over `icon`).

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the textarea's resolved theme color.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the textarea's resolved theme color.
